items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: It’s a great experience for Hamilton to have you, and being a player, I think that is so inspirational.

ctx.x: But I ended up in this area and this has been a great experience meeting all my jazz heroes through this project.
